sloka: नैर्ऋताधिपते वाक्यं यदुक्तं ते विभीषण।भूयस्तच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि ब्रूहि यत्ते विवक्षितम् ।। ६.८५.३ ।।
transliteration: nairṛtādhipate vākyaṁ yaduktaṁ te vibhīṣaṇa।bhūyastacchrotumicchāmi brūhi yatte vivakṣitam ।। 6.85.3 ।।

translations.english: "O Lord of Rakshasas, Vibheeshana! I wish to hear the words spoken by you. You may repeat that which you wanted to convey. I wish to hear."
